printNote.text: Print always prints the WHOLE worksheet, never just the question on screen. The button says how many questions, and a print preview always opens first. Drawing questions are tap-to-answer on screen and real draw-it questions on paper.

examNote.text: Exam papers copy the school's real Periodic Test: header, instructions, boxed sections with marks on the right (MCQ 3x1, One word 2x1, Short answer 3x2, Long answer 3x3, Fill in the blanks 5x1 = 25 marks, 60 min). The Term Exam (50 marks, 2.5 hours) pattern is a proposal to confirm. Parents choose the units; questions come only from those.

paperNote.text: Paper first, then the app. Print the worksheet, do the rough work in a copy, then enter just the answers here. Every printed sheet has a code in its footer, and the app remembers the sheets you printed, so the same questions come back.

mathsNote.text: Units come from the real book contents (12 units). Unit 1 topics are an example from its first pages; the real topic list for every unit is read from the book and checked so no question type is missed.
